messages:
rachel_pm: Heads up — EdgeRetail (on-prem appliance partner) flagged ~2k mismatched SKUs in last 7 days vs our marketplace ledger. They say their gateway batches CSVs and we’re double-mapping some entitlements. Can we triage?

sam_engineering: Noted. Do we have an example CSV row or the partner payload?

mina_partner_eng: I pulled a sample from EdgeRetail: they send `sku_alias` and `plan_code`. We map by `sku_id`. They recently rolled out aliases for promos so `sku_alias: RETAIL_STD` maps to two internal SKUs depending on region.

leo_revenueops: Oof. That explains billing drift. Which side decides canonical mapping? EdgeRetail assumed upstream canonicalization.

mina_partner_eng: They expected marketplace to prefer `plan_code` when present. Our ingest currently prefers `sku_id` if supplied — we don't fall back to `plan_code` until after dedupe logic.

sam_engineering: Quick fix idea: change ingest priority to: if plan_code exists and matches a single active plan -> use plan_code mapping; else fallback to sku_id. Low-risk canary?

rachel_pm: We also need retroactive reconciliation for invoices issued this month. Ops wants to avoid credits if mapping can be deterministically fixed.

leo_revenueops: Can we produce a delta file (trusted_changes.csv) and surface affected invoice ids? If amount < $5k we can handle via balance adjustments; larger need legal sign-off.

mina_partner_eng: I'll ask EdgeRetail for a compact delta sample. Meanwhile, @sam can you list the ingestion code paths touched? Tag any database migration risk.

sam_engineering: Affected files: `marketplace/ingest/parsers/csv_gateway.py` and `ingest/rules/mapping_priority.py`. No DB schema change. Canary plan: deploy mapping toggle behind `feature.flag.edge_alias_priority`. Release window target: tomorrow 10:00 PT.

release-bot: next-deploy scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 PT -> canary: 10% -> ramp if error_rate < 0.5% over 15m.

rachel_pm: Good. Ops playbook for reconciliation: 1) run mapping toggle in canary, 2) reprocess 72h of batches in dry-run mode to produce `reconciled_delta.csv`, 3) review top-accounts by delta. Who owns step 2?

sam_engineering: I can run the dry-run once the toggle is live. Need compute window from infra.

mina_partner_eng: I'll coordinate with EdgeRetail to freeze any alias changes during the reprocess window (target window: 03/28 00:00-03:28 UTC).

leo_revenueops: After dry-run, I want sample billing preview for top 10 accounts and an estimate of credits. If it exceeds $2k per account, we escalate.

rachel_pm: Also planning note — EdgeRetail PR for joint announcement next week. We must confirm metering integrity before go-live. Proposed blocker: do not ship public go-live until we run reconciliation and confirm <0.5% invoice drift on sample.

mina_partner_eng: Agreed. I'll tell their comms team: pause announcement until we give green.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-ER-SKU-MAP, severity: low -> owner: sam_engineering.

sam_engineering: Action items: 1) implement feature flag change (PR today), 2) wire dry-run job with reprocess script, 3) share `reconciled_delta.csv` in this thread. ETA: PR by EOD, dry-run after canary stable.

leo_revenueops: I'll draft a short memo for finance with preview columns: account_id, invoice_id, old_charge, new_charge, delta_usd, reconciliation_action.

rachel_pm: Thanks team. If we hit any unexpected idempotency problems reprocessing older batches, notify immediately and pause.

mina_partner_eng: FYI sample payload snippet EdgeRetail provided:
```json
{
  "timestamp":"2026-03-25T12:34:00Z",
  "sku_alias":"RETAIL_STD",
  "sku_id":"sk_9876",
  "plan_code":"monthly_standard_us",
  "usage_units":1200,
  "seller_type":"onprem_gateway",
  "signature":"X-Market-Sig: ..."
}
```

sam_engineering: Also adding validation: require either sku_id or plan_code, and log ambiguous mappings to Sentry with tag `partner:edgeretail` so we can triage quickly.

rachel_pm: Can we try to have a decision and preliminary delta by EOD tomorrow? If not, push announcement hold to next week.

mina_partner_eng: I'll confirm freeze with EdgeRetail and send their sample delta by lunchtime tomorrow. :thumbsup:

leo_revenueops: I'll prep billing preview template and share by 09:30 PT tomorrow.

sam_engineering: PR opened: https://git.redwood/integrations/ingest/pulls/432 -> includes feature flag and logging.

release-bot: PR 432 passed CI, queued for canary deploy tomorrow 10:00 PT.

rachel_pm: Great. Closing loop here — will reconvene after dry-run results. Thanks everyone.
